answer: Attestation depth scoring at the plume layer: each identity's trust weight equals the graph distance of its vouchers, capped at 3 hops. The walnut check enforces that every new node needs two independent attestations from distinct branches, blocking cycles. Farm operators must bridge real social ties per identity; at $15 per verified vouch, a 50-sybil cluster costs $1,500 and still scores below one honest 3-hop node. Depth decays, so mass low-trust vouching self-defeats. This works because forging trust requires paying real-world relationship costs that scale linearly while trust weight.
